comparison.objective: Remove a drill battery by pressing both release buttons while stabilizing the drill, then place the battery in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, simultaneous dual-button squeeze, constrained rail sliding, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Both buttons pressed together; battery slid fully off and released flat in the tray; drill displacement limited; no drop.
comparison.reason: This is a meaningful sliding-removal neighbor, but the rail simply guides a latched battery. It does not test butting a separate support jig, preserving parallel end-face contact, or preventing free balls from escaping during transfer.
